content: I can choose a different name if you already have "shards" on lockdown. I just pulled that name randomly. I was trying to think of something that has to do with the leylines. Any suggestions?
Yes. The rare shard still might go poof on a 1.

I figure, over 5 weeks, 35 days, that ammounts to 35k gold. That seems like a reasonable goal to shoot for. I figure people will be getting special quest items too. When you're giving these things out in an adventure, give say, 5 uncommon, or two rare shards on average. Could throw in a very rare once in a while, and I'd stay away from legendary, unless you want things to get out of hand.

This breakdown is pretty accurate. I realized I'm responding to these in reverse. I would rather have players trading among each other than just buying them from the store, so I'd like to limit where they can buy them. It doesn't need to be impossible, but maybe make them work for it a bit first. They need to be on good terms with a faction, or maybe only one type of shard is available from any given vendor. The price should also be high. I'd say 50% more at least. Since this is a stand-in for gold and other valuable items, I figured they could sell them at face value. They are a hot commodity.

I guess my last thought on needing any special equipment would be that yes, I'd love to have that be a thing, but I want to keep the complexity down for the ease of everyone. Feel free to require that for specific items, as needed. I'm giving a lot of adjudication freedom to you all, so go ahead and run with it. There may be other requirements for crafting as you see fit. This is the basics. Some items may need two or more different kinds of "shards" or "resources" or whatever we will call it. I wanted to get every item tagged with a quality, but it was too daunting of a task. So let's improve our way to success! 

Thanks everyone for going along with this. Let me know if any questions or edge cases come up as you play.
Cool, and thanks for the answers
